cause: A cited-entry smoke build found that alpha.bst truncates an unprotected control sequence in the DLMF key to an undefined control sequence.
change: Add literal outer TeX braces to key: {\relax DLMF} -> {{\relax DLMF}}. The complete DLMF label is preserved and no new macro/package is needed.
metadata_unchanged: Authors, titles, versions, dates, DOI, URL and all scientific/cited old bibliography entries are unchanged. Only a BibTeX label field is protected.
workflow: Reopen affected units in dependency order; new original-role signatures are still required. All BIB-001 rounds remain historical records; do not edit them.
